about: PitchTracker display fields at 60 Hz for tuner scenarios; regenerate with SEDEF_TUNER_FIXTURES=<this file> sedef_engine_tests [tuner-fixtures]

scenarios.name: e2-hum
scenarios.what: E2 in tune, 60 Hz hum 28 dB under the note

scenarios.name: g3-real
scenarios.what: G3 in tune, +-1 cent wobble, -1.5 c/s sag, hum

scenarios.name: a2-after-e2
scenarios.what: A2 3 cents sharp while the E2 plucked 1 s earlier rings

scenarios.name: a2-peg
scenarios.what: A2 20 cents flat, peg turned up to pitch over 1 s

scenarios.name: g3-step
scenarios.what: G3 20 cents flat, steps to pitch at 1 s

scenarios.name: e4-repluck
scenarios.what: E4 6 cents flat, muted, retuned and picked again

scenarios.name: e2-peg35
scenarios.what: E2 35 cents flat, peg turned up to pitch over 1.2 s

scenarios.name: e2-repluck-turning
scenarios.what: E2 picked again while the peg turns it up from 30 cents flat

scenarios.name: d2-to-e2
scenarios.what: D2 turned up to E2 over 0.8 s (drop D to standard)

scenarios.name: e2-flat-hammer
scenarios.what: E2 45 cents flat, hammer-on to the next fret at 1 s

scenarios.name: a2-ref-held
scenarios.what: A2 in tune dies; the reference goes to 420 Hz at 2.2 s
